name: Nominal Broad U.S. Dollar Index
notes: Daily values published weekly in H.10 (Mondays, 16:15 ET; next Federal business day if Monday is a Federal holiday); usable at the first close after that release.

name: Federal Funds Effective Rate
notes: Monthly average of daily rates; computable after the month ends. Assumed usable at the first close after 16:15 ET on the first calendar day of the next month (i.e. the second session of month m+1 when day 1 is a session).

name: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: All Items in U.S. City Average
notes: BLS CPI is released ~10th-15th of m+1 (later in the 1980s; 24 Oct 2025 for Sep 2025). Assumed usable at the first close on/after the last calendar day of m+1 (later than every release found).

name: Unemployment Rate
notes: Employment Situation is normally the first Friday of m+1. Assumed: first close on/after the last day of m+1; the Sep 2025 release (20 Nov 2025) is a dated override.

name: University of Michigan: Consumer Sentiment
notes: FRED posts this series with a one-month delay requested by the source; the final UMich value for month m is public around the end of m. Assumed: first close after the end of m+1.

name: Industrial Production: Total Index
notes: G.17 is normally released mid m+1 at 09:15 ET. Assumed: first close on/after the last day of m+1; the shutdown-delayed Sep/Oct 2025 releases are dated overrides.

name: Producer Price Index by Industry: Semiconductor and Related Device Manufacturing
notes: Descriptive input-cost proxy (RT-21). BLS PPI is normally released mid m+1 at 08:30 ET; values are preliminary for four months. Shutdown-delayed Sep-Nov 2025 releases are dated overrides.
